question: In which of the following states is the Bissu Mela organised to thank Santoora Devi for the good harvest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bissu Mela is a traditional festival celebrated in Uttarakhand.
 
• The festival is organized to thank Santoora Devi for a bountiful harvest.
 
• Bissu Mela is celebrated primarily in the Jaunsar-Bawar region of Uttarakhand.
 
• The festival marks the beginning of the harvest season and is an important cultural event for the local community.
 
• People participate in various cultural activities, including traditional dances and songs, during the mela.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaunsar-Bawar Region:** This region is known for its distinct cultural heritage and traditions, located in the Dehradun district of Uttarakhand.
 
• **Santoora Devi:** Santoora Devi is a revered deity in the region, and the Bissu Mela is organized to honor her and seek blessings for a good harvest.
 
• **Traditional Attire:** During the Bissu Mela, people dress in their traditional attire, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of the area.
 
• **Folk Dances and Songs:** The mela features various folk dances and songs, which are integral to the celebration and reflect the local customs and traditions.
 
• **Harvest Festivals in India:** Similar to Bissu Mela, other harvest festivals in India include Pongal in Tamil Nadu, Baisakhi in Punjab, and Makar Sankranti in various parts of the country.
